news.title: Fury in California After Trump Suggests Iran Could ‘Take Out’ L.A. or San Diego
news.summary: Gov. Gavin Newsom called the president “dangerous and deranged” after his remarks at a political rally, where Mr. Trump said the Iran war was necessary to “keep the world safe.”
